allowed_information: Displayed matrix only, no target, key, metadata, seed, answer catalog or solution. Unique-negative subgroup is selected by counting negative displayed cells. Target/key is used only to score predictions after selecting them.
bypassed_work: All strategies omit the requested subscript and its row/column interpretation; unique-negative uses sign recognition as a possible cue instead.
limits: Small final batches and 200 fresh ordinary cases per band are diagnostic, not confirmation of a defect or universal absence of shortcuts. No per-batch balance quota follows.
